title: Senior-most Member to Preside over the Bench

content.scenario: In the State Commission of Maharashtra, a Bench is constituted with three members. The senior-most member, Mr. Kumar, is required to preside over the Bench as per the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The senior-most member, Mr. Kumar, shall preside over the Bench as it is mandatory for the senior-most member to do so. This ensures that the Bench is headed by the most experienced member, which is essential for fair and efficient dispute resolution.

user_queries: Who presides over the Bench in the State Commission?
